basic_info.description: Welcome to 42 Putnam, a period gem crisply updated for today's lifestyle w/ 2 main-level bedrooms plus a flexible downstairs suite- perfect as a guest retreat, office, creative studio or all of the above! On the main level, light pours through the east-facing living room w/peekaboo view of the Bay & gas fireplace w/period mantle. Entertainment ready, the living room flows into a gracious-sized full dining room. The stylishly updated kitchen boasts quartz countertops, stainless appliances, great storage & natural light. A spacious primary bedroom w/yard outlooks, 2nd bedroom w/direct access to the garden & full bath complete the main level. The downstairs suite features 2 rooms, a full bath, wet bar & direct outdoor access, providing additional space to live, work, & play. Low maintenance zen garden offers private space to dine, entertain & enjoy the sun amidst mature trees & raised beds with dog run area! A wide one-car garage includes EV charger, laundry, storage & space to tinker. Updates include newer roof, heater, updated electrical panel & water main. Nestled on a quiet one-way street, easy stroll down Jarboe to Cortland Ave beloved cafes, restaurants, parks and shops. This home combines modern flexibility & understated sophistication with the vibrant charm of Bernal Heights
